create_PreTrainedModel_from_pretrained: create a pretrained PyTorch model from a model name, path, or TensorFlow checkpoint with optional config overrides
create_PretrainedConfig_from_pretrained: create a model configuration object from a pretrained model name, directory path, or JSON file with optional kwarg overrides
build_SequenceSummary: build a sequence summary module that extracts a vector from hidden states using last, first, mean, or cls_index strategies
build_SQuADHead: build a SQuAD question-answering head that computes start and end logits with beam-search inference and training loss
refactor_prune_layer: refactor a Conv1D or nn.Linear layer to prune specific attention heads and return a pruned layer with updated weights
